{'text': '中國媒體界面新聞近日發表的一篇報導，帶來 iPhone Duo 生產的最新消息，包括產量、組裝難題等。', 'source': 'Chinese', 'translation': 'Chinese media outlet Jiemian News recently published a report bringing the latest updates on iPhone Duo production, including yield figures and assembly challenges.'}

{'text': '最新 iPhone Duo 報導涵蓋生產困難、目標庫存等內容', 'source': 'Chinese', 'translation': 'The latest iPhone Duo report covers production difficulties and target inventory levels'}

{'text': 'iPhone Duo 將於 10 月 16 日開始預訂，即是兩星期後。界面新聞最近一篇報導就提供了 Apple 生產狀況的最新更新。', 'source': 'Chinese', 'translation': "The iPhone Duo will go up for pre-order on October 16, just two weeks away. A recent report from Jiemian News provides the latest update on Apple's production status."}

{'text': '我們之前看過的報導都提過，Apple 摺機因為組裝工序複雜，量產速度很慢。', 'source': 'Chinese', 'translation': "Previous reports we've seen have noted that Apple's foldable is slow to ramp up mass production due to the complexity of the assembly process."}

{'text': '據報目前 iPhone Duo 的組裝良率僅僅稍高於 60%。界面新聞指，供應商認為產能良率要達到「成熟」水平，可能還要六個月或更長時間。', 'source': 'Chinese', 'translation': 'The current assembly yield rate for the iPhone Duo is reportedly only slightly above 60%. According to Jiemian News, suppliers believe it could take another six months or more for production yields to reach a "mature" level.'}

{'text': '這個數字遠低於其他型號的預期水平，但考慮到 Duo 採用了全新的產品設計和零件，可能又不算太意外。', 'source': 'Chinese', 'translation': 'This figure is well below expected levels for other models, but it may not be entirely surprising given that the Duo features an entirely new product design and components.'}

{'text': '報導指 Apple 目標是在 2026 年前準備好 600 萬至 800 萬部 iPhone Duo。相比之下，新一代 Pro 或 Pro Max 旗艦機型一般會有 2000 萬至 3000 萬部。', 'source': 'Chinese', 'translation': 'The report indicates Apple is targeting 6 to 8 million iPhone Duo units prepared by 2026. By comparison, a new generation of Pro or Pro Max flagship models typically sees 20 to 30 million units.'}

{'text': 'iPhone Duo 起步價 1,999 美元，加上獨特的機身設計，目標客群無 iPhone 18 Pro 和 Pro Max 那麼廣。摺機市場整體來說仍然相對小眾。', 'source': 'Chinese', 'translation': 'With the iPhone Duo starting at $1,999 and its unique body design, the target audience is not as broad as that of the iPhone 18 Pro and Pro Max. The foldable market as a whole remains relatively niche.'}

{'text': '如果 Apple 在 2026 年底前賣到接近 800 萬部，肯定會被視為重大勝利。但 iPhone Duo 最終能否成功，更加取決於長遠的受歡迎程度。究竟只是吸引早期採用者，還是都能夠成為主流市場的熱賣產品？', 'source': 'Chinese', 'translation': 'If Apple manages to sell close to 8 million units by the end of 2026, it would certainly be considered a significant victory. But whether the iPhone Duo ultimately succeeds will depend more on its long-term popularity. Will it only attract early adopters, or can it become a mainstream hit?'}

{'text': '有消息人士向界面新聞透露，Apple 至今不願意為 iPhone Duo 放寬嚴格的品質標準，所以才導致良率低於預期。雖然這可能會令新機上市時出現缺貨，但我相信肯花 2,000 美元以上買 iPhone 的人都想要最高品質的產品，所以這也不算是壞消息。', 'source': 'Chinese', 'translation': "Sources told Jiemian News that Apple has so far been unwilling to relax its strict quality standards for the iPhone Duo, which is why yields are below expectations. While this may lead to stock shortages at launch, I believe anyone willing to spend over $2,000 on an iPhone wants the highest quality product, so this isn't necessarily bad news."}

{'text': '你打算買 iPhone Duo 嗎？原因是什麼？歡迎在留言區分享。', 'source': 'Chinese', 'translation': 'Are you planning to buy the iPhone Duo? Why or why not? Feel free to share in the comments.'}
